senses.gloss: The ninth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet; the aspirate of the preceding letter, and corresponding in power to Jh.

mfn. (झः झा झं)
1 Asleep, sleeping.
2 Lost, destroyed.
m. (झः)
1 A name of VṚHASPATI, preceptor of the gods.
2 A name of the chief of the Daityas or demons.
3 Sound, or a sort of sound like the splashing of water, or the clashing of cymbals, jangling, clanging, &c.
4 High wind.
5 A stray, a thing lost or mislaid.
6 Playing a tune, beating time.
f. (झा)
The descent of a cascade, a water fall.
E.
झट to collect, affix ड.
